scope: Partial chapter 7 author support: batch 1, all 123 fixed source objects S1428–S1550 / 37 pairs MTP-000453–MTP-000489 reviewed against the actual English and 23 translator notes. Later chapter ranges are not yet covered by this ledger.
policy: Compact records group actual source loci and reader-linked local notes. All provisional usages remain proposed. Unrendered unresolved Tibetan stays in translator notes and receives no invented equivalent. Routine canonical repetitions, ordinary function words and obvious environmental/body/adornment nouns are excluded unless a technical sense, collision or material construction requires a record.
